data.body:
fix-bug:investigation

VERDICT: LIVE — triggered when merge-to-main-pr.sh is invoked directly (bypass dispatcher) with MERGE_STRATEGY unset.

ROOT CAUSE: merge-to-main-pr.sh lines 70-81 sets MERGE_STRATEGY as a bash local variable but does NOT export it. When _state_init is called (line 2891), it spawns python3 which reads os.environ.get("MERGE_STRATEGY", "direct"). Since MERGE_STRATEGY was never exported, python3 sees the default: "direct". The state file is written with merge_strategy="direct" even though the config resolves to "pr".

On --resume, merge-to-main.sh (the dispatcher) reads dso.workflow=ci-pr → MERGE_STRATEGY="pr" (correctly). It then reads the state file merge_strategy field → "direct". Cross-strategy mismatch fires (lines 95-96), abort.

EXACT FILES + LINES:
(a) State write (bug site): plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh line 138 — os.environ.get("MERGE_STRATEGY", "direct") defaults to "direct" when MERGE_STRATEGY is not exported.
(b) --resume check that aborts: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh lines 82-101 — reads merge_strategy from state JSON, rejects when != MERGE_STRATEGY.

TRIGGER CONDITION (precise): merge-to-main-pr.sh invoked DIRECTLY (not via merge-to-main.sh dispatcher). MERGE_STRATEGY derives correctly at lines 70-78 but is not exported. When invoked via dispatcher (chunk 8 scenario), MERGE_STRATEGY is exported at dispatcher line 106 before exec, so the downstream script inherits it — that is why --resume worked correctly in chunk 8.

FIX APPROACH: Add "export MERGE_STRATEGY" after line 78 in merge-to-main-pr.sh (or change assignments at lines 75/77 to "export MERGE_STRATEGY=pr" / "export MERGE_STRATEGY=direct"). Single-line fix.

FILE: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh — after line 78, before line 81.

RED TEST PLAN: Add test to tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh. Test name: test_state_init_writes_pr_strategy_when_not_exported. Scenario: source merge-helpers.sh; set MERGE_STRATEGY=pr as a local bash var (NOT exported); call _state_init with a unique BRANCH; read merge_strategy from the state file. Assert == "pr". RED before fix (reads "direct"). GREEN after fix (reads "pr" because export propagates to python3 env). The existing test 8 harness (source merge-helpers.sh + inspect state JSON) is directly reusable for this test.
